Definition: from the same as G2337; female:--female, woman.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thēlys means female. In Matthew 19:4, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, and it appears again in Mark 10:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe female still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
